Hi all, I have been going through parts for a few days now and was hoping you could help with some opinions on the parts I've chosen.

What I need: I need to replace my weak ARM based media player with something future proof that can

  1. Run Kodi and be able to play the larger BD rips I have (12-16 GB, current player chokes on these and lower res ones as well)
  2. Be able to run handbrake, makemkv, etc and other tasks I would prefer not to run on my laptop
  3. Ideally run Steam and be able to play newer games on high settings. I'm not a hardcore gamer and don't need ultra settings or anything like that. This will be displayed on a TV, not a high res monitor anyway.
  4. Run inside my TV cabinet without too much heat and preferable very silently. The cabinet has an inside width of about 48 cm and has a semi-open back. If it's doing something intense like gaming then a bit more noise and heat is expected but for watching movies I would like it whisper quiet if possible.

What I have: Storage - QNAP NAS with plenty of space remaining so I have no need for storing large amounts of data on the HTPC.

When do I want to get it? As soon as possible. There's always something new coming. I'd rather invest in a few good components that I can move into another system later if I choose to.

Budget: Around £1,000 but a bit more is OK for a better build that runs quiet and will last me some time.

Parts:

http://uk.pcpartpicker.com/p/khsvpg

  • CPU: Intel Core i5-4570S 2.9GHz Quad-Core Processor
  • CPU Cooler: Noctua NH-L9i 57.5 CFM CPU Cooler
  • Motherboard: Gigabyte GA-Z97N-Gaming 5 Mini ITX LGA1150 Motherboard
  • Memory: Kingston HyperX Fury Blue 8GB (1 x 8GB) DDR3-1866 Memory
  • Storage: Samsung 850 Pro Series 512GB 2.5" Solid State Drive
  • Video Card: GALAX GeForce GTX 970 4GB Infinity Black Edition Video Card
  • Case: Fractal Design Node 202 HTPC Case
  • Power Supply: Silverstone Strider Gold 450W 80+ Gold Certified Fully-Modular SFX Power Supply
  • Case Fan: Corsair Air Series SP120 Quiet Edition (2-Pack) 37.9 CFM 120mm Fans

The box will spend most of its time in Linux running Kodi. I'm planning to split the HDD something like 200GB Linux, 300 GB Windows.

I haven't tried building a box in many many years and put this list together after just some quick research. I'm hoping for someone with better knowledge has some opinions.

Thanks in advance for any suggestions.
